description: Every movie theater in San Francisco in one verified listing — first-run chains, independents, and repertory houses (35mm, 70mm, IMAX). SceneF checks every showtime against each theater's own calendar daily and publishes its accuracy record at scenef.com/accuracy. Ask what's playing tonight, where a film screens this week, or plan a movie night by time, format, or neighborhood. Includes ratings, formats, and sold-out honesty. Answers come from SceneF's own dataset; every ticket link goes to the theater's own box office. San Francisco today, California expansion in progress. No ticket sales — links out only.
